svg.title: Study lighting carrier and conventional home-run comparison
svg.desc: Source-derived geometric review. Luminaire symbols show placement and intended use, not measured light distribution or accepted materials.
svg.text: Earlier 75 mm corner · carrier and first release
Dead-mock-up geometry · fixed islands stay independent · anchors, circuit, materials and physical trial unqualified
Positive front carrier
260 × 450 × 2 mm frame
Four positive front fixings; two fixed side rails
Hard lands carry loads directly to masonry
No load through decoration or mineral board
Depth and actual demand
Core face Y 3177.5 mm; datum is not decorative face
Module G 29.430 N; face moment 5.2974 Nm
Core moment 7.5046 Nm (includes 75 mm stand-off)
Fixing rows 420 mm apart; couple 17.8682 N
Equal upper fixing 8.9341 N; no anchor rating inferred
Carrier stock upper comparison 0.84152 kg
Remaining 2.15848 kg is a budget, not actual installed mass
Local entry starts X 1009; side-entry radius 70 mm
Outer bend requirement 80 mm; three independent fixed boxes
Straight collar 30 mm; left setting gap 9 mm (needs 5)
Local depth axes differ; common riser, feeder/protection and transitions remain unresolved
Removal follows factory body/bracket access after isolation and support
Full module is released only after the electrical disconnection is safe
Real box depths behind the finish · enlarged
Socket box d 28..75 mm; fixed island interrupts decoration
Junction d 13.5..60.5; own cover; carrier d 62.5..64.5
Full fitting + module first rest
Draw 50 mm, translate into rest, then lower upright into captive cradle
Parked module Z 100..550 mm; cradle 310 × 300 mm
Complete swept footprint has 0 current furniture conflicts
Cradle capacity/floor support, actual human handling and full supplied tail remain unqualified
Ordinary infill: support → release four front screws → normal draw; fixed electrical islands and reveal remain closed.
Never enable an opened repair enclosure. Reconnect earth/strain relief, reinstate closures and verify before energising.
Simplify the corner · three conventional separate home runs
Unselected development direction · keep ordinary flush accessories; no bespoke splitter, recessed controls or in-corner depth transition
410 mm local bay · 100 mm wider to the left
Door/reveal datum fixed; complete carrier and accessories shift 1 mm left
Candidate depth 95 mm vs earlier 75 mm; added floor territory 0.01300 m²
The innermost tube ends at the socket; the next ends at the switch
The outer tube rises to the light after the lower tubes have ended
No tube crosses a continuing lower run; all three retain independent support
Bend radii 70 / 111 / 152 mm; minimum pair reserve 10.993 mm after 10 mm pair setting
Routes clear within the declared geometry; actual terminal and fault qualification remain open
Tube 2565.1 mm + gross collars 90 mm; 11 authored clip positions
Known containment steel 1.701 kg; not complete installed mass
New fixed saddle receiver 0.07850 kg; actual saddle mass/strength unqualified
2 actual north-wall pieces intersect the wider replacement bay
Symmetric carrier retained; ordinary 16 mm steel frames keep the lower controls flush
Tube sources Z375 mm; source-bound circuit shown in working-house sheet
Ports are authored requirements within current reference box envelopes
Actual Barton side ports and matched hardware remain unqualified
Tube/actual steel reserve 19.500 mm after both settings
Ordinary upper-bend saddle splits its span to 169.4 / 149.4 mm
Closed junction/carrier reserve 5.5 mm; actual full-face clearance is charged
Actual steel strips, full saddle/receiver, hand tool, boxes, furniture and first rest are checked
The old shallow full face, narrow spacing or absent bend saddle fail the retained screens
The old75 mm full-face arrangement fails; actual box ports/connections remain unqualified
Wera205 ×37 mm tool witness; base-first after cover/tube release
D-Line86.19 ×20 ×23 mm saddle witness; bend/anchor/loaded handling unqualified
Complete depth and ordinary enclosure renewal
Enlarged depth budget; fixed cases/closures are independent of decoration and the removable fitting carrier
Upper box d 18..65 mm; own cover 65..67
Retained carrier d 82.5..84.5 mm; timber face ends at 95 mm
Two ordinary 16 mm lower frames: 0.140672 kg at authored2 mm wall stock
Actual supplied gauges/lugs/weights, mating entries, device/earth/union and protection remain unqualified
Park fitting/module first; its support territory moves 60 mm south
Then place separate 120 ×120 mm case rest; 7 mm after both settings
Complete closed-case draws: 83 / 83 / 97 mm; lower in the cleared plane
Whole cases, remaining closed fronts/pipes, protected lands, furniture and both support footprints are charged
Own collar release, actual loaded handling and complete cradle capacity remain unqualified
Geometric design comparison only. Hardware, materials, protection, installed mass, physical trial and owner appearance remain unearned.
